title: The whole __*__ namespace is dropped, not just ___ - including entire subtrees
rationale: SECURITY.md scopes NP-022 to a field literally named ___. The predicate is a namespace filter, so __, __meta__, __id__ and every other __x__ name is dropped too, and when the name belongs to an OBJECT the entire subtree goes with it. _x_ is the control: it fails startsWith("__") and must survive.
catchesBugClass: Under-scoped defect documentation. Pins the true blast radius and pins that a correct fix must restore the whole namespace rather than one string. The _x_ control blocks an over-broad "reject any key containing __" fix.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch a __x__ name appearing as a field INSIDE an array element, where reconstructArray strips markers by explicit remove() and does not apply the startsWith/endsWith filter.

predicted.detail: Two of three top-level fields are gone, one of them a whole subtree; the _x_ control survives.
